label: Self-origination assessed through the existing existential-production proof
summary: Warrant and derivation assessment of the bare STMT-NOTHING-ORIGINATES-ITSELF, without premise discharge. DEF-CAUSE-OF-ORIGIN paraphrases an originating cause as 'other than the thing itself', but its primitive CausesOrigin field does not enforce distinctness and the conclusion is not obtained by that definition. The previously verified noSelf result from four OPEN mixed-token priority conditions excludes an act producing its own bearer's existence: an occurring exercise presupposes its bearer's existence, production of existence is explanatorily prior to its product, and one transitive irreflexive order forbids the resulting two-step cycle. No temporal precedence is needed. New explicit bridge OriginHasProductiveExercise says that each CausesOrigin c x edge has an occurring exercise a borne by c that produces x's existence. New argument noSelfOriginFromNoSelfProduction derives the bare target from this OPEN bridge plus the existing NoSelfProduction statement; the latter retains its four-premise certified support route. The Solution also contains a direct Lean composition invoking the prior noSelf theorem. The challenge, corpus argument/result and comparator configuration are registered; their formal verification passed CI on fe55756c. Ordinary self-repair, feedback after existence and an intrinsic nonproductive explanation do not instantiate production of one's own existence. The strongest distinct rival proposes simultaneous/non-well-founded origination for which bearer-to-act or act-to-product priority fails. The existing unique-feedback Boolean control shows consistency of a feedback constraint, not an actual existential-origin mechanism or independent warrant for that denial. Provisional judgment: the prohibition is strongly supported for genuinely productive origin under the five explicit open premises, while the universal primitive statement stays unestablished. Independent semantic challenge found no P1 in the staged bridge/proof/records and identified this bookkeeping update as P2. No new source attribution or rival refutation is claimed. Follow-up warrant reassessment (2026-11-12, docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md): Aristotle Physics II.3's builder/building distinction supplies positive conceptual warrant for an occurring exercise when an originating cause is an ACTUAL positive efficient producer, but no deductive universal passage from observed production to primitive CausesOrigin. Hall's dependence/production distinction supports a substantive wider causal reading in which omissions are causes without positive productive activities; its applicability to CAUSE_4 rather than generic event-causation is contested. Aquinas ST I q.45 a.3 distinguishes creation from motion and identifies divine active creation with divine essence, so Occurs must not be misread as a temporal accident or a real distinct act; bearer-to-act priority remains OPEN. Gott and Li (1998) solve self-consistent CTC spacetime/field configurations and separately propose a conditional baby-universe reidentification (later baby universe is the earlier universe); it is not a solved dynamical self-generation model. This is a more concrete research target than the Boolean feedback control, but realizing that reidentification and transferring phase edges to CausesOrigin(whole,whole), and thence to a bearer activity producing the whole's total existence, are independently OPEN; no empirical actuality is claimed. Provisional judgment refined: bridge favored for positive efficient origination, not warranted for all dependence-based causes; no self-origin premise established. Primary text links and precise discriminating tests are preserved in the existing note. Formal CI run 43245028464 and completed Codex review on fe55756c passed with no major findings; the added warrant research is prose only.
blocker: Test the live disputed scope of CausesOrigin: distinguish positive efficient coming-to-be from dependence by omission; identify a physical or metaphysical case if broad CAUSE_4 includes the latter. For the Gott-Li CTC proposal test SAME global universe bearer, phase/whole identity, and whether any act produces the whole universe's existence (not merely an earlier phase); this requires an explicit transfer argument, not a mere cycle. Defend non-temporal bearer-to-act and act-to-product explanatory priority, irreflexivity, and transitivity for the productive interpretation, particularly when action is identical with a necessary being's essence. Root premise and interpretation bridge remain OPEN; no claim of actual-world self-origination or universe beginning.
